curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate suspension from revocation, then the junior sanctions and the adult probation period, comparing the two ladders.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each sanction type and ladder; contrast cards on suspension versus revocation and junior versus probation rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a new driver's violations and asking what sanction follows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain answering tickets and where cases are heard, then how out-of-state convictions and ignored out-of-state tickets affect a New York license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for answering tickets, courts, out-of-state recording and alcohol convictions; a contrast card on recording versus answering.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what happens to a ticket in or outside the state.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the alcohol and drug violation ladder, chemical-test refusals, under-twenty-one convictions and Zero Tolerance, comparing refusal with the underlying offense.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sanction; contrast cards on the refusal and violation ladders and on Zero Tolerance versus refusal.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming an offense and age and asking for the minimum sanction.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover revocations for repeated violations and speed contests, uninsured driving, indefinite suspensions, fatal crashes, and the crime of driving while suspended or revoked.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each mandatory sanction; a contrast card on driving suspended versus the ignored-ticket count.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a driver's record and asking what sanction follows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how the point system works, the point values in the table, the eleven-point suspension rule, and what the crash-prevention course can and cannot do.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the point system, point values, the suspension threshold and the course; a contrast card on relief versus rescue.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on point values and what the course changes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover termination and reapplication fees, stop-arm camera fines, civil penalties before relicensing, and the two driver responsibility assessment tracks, then compare the two point clocks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each fee, penalty and assessment; contrast cards on the two assessment tracks, the two point clocks and the civil penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the fee amounts and the assessment triggers.
